postSubject: If all it takes to scare you is jump scares, you're in for a treatIf it takes more than jump scares to frighten you, save your money.The free PT demo on Playstation 4 network is 100x more scary than this game, and there is only one jump scare in it, at that its completely random and a lot of players never get it, which is what makes it in itself scary cause you don't know its going to happen, just that it could happen.This, you always know that when you see them on the camera's near your room, they will be outside it in moments and you lock the door, which in itself explains the power mechanic because without it what little tension is there would evaporate in seconds.Again if you love jump scares you'll love this game, and I don't want to sound like an old codger but it takes a lot more to scare some people
